title: Now card: padding in the tab content area

message.text: Taken: the content inside each tab gets the page's normal padding, so nothing sits against the left edge. The tab strip itself stays edge to edge. The same builder does it together with the chat sidebar and the tab pages.
Got it: no default padding anywhere. The existing `pad` class goes only on the Now card's tab content, so no-padding stays the default everywhere else. The builder has the change.
